description: Header file defining the Monitor plugin class for WPEFramework, including nested classes for configuration, metadata, and monitoring objects, with methods for initialization, state change handling, snapshotting, and event actions.

classes.name: Monitor
classes.description: Main plugin class implementing monitoring functionality, including nested classes for configuration, metadata, and monitoring objects, with methods for plugin lifecycle and request processing.

classes.name: Monitor::MetaData
classes.description: Class representing memory and process metadata, with measurement data and operational status.

classes.name: Monitor::Data
classes.description: JSON container class for reporting monitor data, including name, measurement, observable, and restart info.

classes.name: Monitor::RestartInfo
classes.description: JSON container class for restart window and limit configuration.

classes.name: Monitor::MonitorObjects
classes.description: Class managing collection of MonitorObject instances, handling state changes, snapshotting, and dispatching evaluations.

classes.name: Monitor::MonitorObjects::MonitorObject
classes.description: Class representing individual monitored entities with restart, evaluation, and measurement logic.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with service information.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the plugin, cleaning up resources.

methods.name: Process
methods.description: Processes web requests and generates responses.

methods.name: event_action
methods.description: Triggers an event action with callsign, action, and reason.
